criteria.text: Given the repo is checked out on main, When the gate runs, Then the wall tests pass
Given the repo is checked out on a feature branch, When the gate runs, Then the wall tests pass
Given an injected protected branch, When a push is decided, Then it is denied
Given an injected feature branch, When a push is decided, Then the ordinary outward push ASK is returned
Given the shared fixture, When it is inspected, Then it injects git state rather than leaving it ambient
